text:
Sam: quick heads-up — proposing we change attribution key from fingerprint -> (tenant_id, request_fingerprint, epoch)
Priya: shorthand — why add epoch? seems like compaction pain
Marta: because late-arrival replay can map to previous epoch; epoch helps avoid double-claim on compacted ledger :thinking_face:
Sam: exactly. current flow uses fingerprint only and we get duplicate credits after compaction/backfill
Jon: can you sketch event schema? makes it easier
Sam: sure:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "request_fingerprint": "abc123",
  "epoch": "2026-03-01",
  "model": "rwd-1",
  "tokens": 120,
  "source": "ingest",
  "receipt_ts": 1728882468
}
```
Priya: ok, if we include epoch then finalizer has to map late arrivals to epoch ranges — that is extra state
Sam: true — tradeoff: more finalizer state vs simpler dedupe at ledger level
Marta: another option: keep fingerprint but add provenance pointer to handshake_id. handshake_id ~= lease+offset. small change to ingest
Jon: handshake_id ties us to the ingestion plumbing — scary for long-term compatibility
Sam: proposal: canonical event keeps (tenant_id, fingerprint); handshake_id is optional provenance. finalizer reconciles by preferring events with matching handshake_id when present, else uses epoch window
Priya: how do we handle backfills that re-emit older handshake_ids? we need proof-of-inclusion marker
Marta: we can emit an audit marker in compacted ledger: compact_marker:{epoch,commit_ts,ledger_offset}
Sam: ops-bot: created ticket INF-2374 for finalizer-state+audit markers :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: link: https://our.tracker/INF-2374
Jon: I'm worried about memory usage for finalizer if epoch granularity is daily — maybe use rolling windows and TTL
Sam: last thought — we'll run a week of shadowing with handshake_id optional, use heuristics to detect duplicates, then flip
Priya: +1 to shadowing. can we keep a cheap bloom per tenant to reduce false positives?
Marta: bloom is fine, but make sure we persist seeds for audits
Sam: thanks all — will drop RFC followup with diagrams and perf sims later
Priya: thanks, Sam :thumbsup:
